```python
from functools import lru_cache

@lru_cache(maxsize=None)
def fib(n):
    if n < 2:
        return n
    return fib(n-1) + fib(n-2)
```

Or manual memoization:

```python
def fib_memo(n, memo={}):
    if n in memo:
        return memo[n]
    if n < 2:
        return n
    memo[n] = fib_memo(n-1, memo) + fib_memo(n-2, memo)
    return memo[n]
```
